fields.name: 营销GMV贡献
fields.description: 统计周期内，活动期间通过优惠券使用记录明确关联至营销活动的有效订单实付金额。同一活动内按订单去重。
fields.formula_description: 对每个营销活动，汇总订单创建时间落在活动期间和统计周期交集内的有效订单实付金额；关联由 t_coupon_usage.campaign_id 与 order_id 确定，状态 5 和 6 的订单排除。
fields.sql_template:
WITH campaign_orders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT campaign_id, order_id
  FROM t_coupon_usage
  WHERE order_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name,
  COUNT(o.order_id) AS effective_order_count,
  ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(o.payment_amount), 0), 2) AS campaign_gmv
FROM t_campaign AS c
LEFT JOIN campaign_orders AS co ON co.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
LEFT JOIN t_order AS o ON o.order_id = co.order_id
  AND o.status NOT IN (5, 6)
  AND o.gmt_create BETWEEN c.start_time AND c.end_time
  AND o.gmt_create >= '{date_start}' AND o.gmt_create < '{date_end}'
WHERE c.start_time < '{date_end}' AND c.end_time >= '{date_start}'
GROUP BY c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name
ORDER BY c.campaign_id

fields.sql_template:
SELECT AVG(p.avg_rating) AS avg_product_rating,
  COUNT(*) AS sold_product_count,
  COUNT(p.avg_rating) AS rated_product_count
FROM t_product AS p
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM t_order_item AS i
  JOIN t_order AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
  WHERE i.product_id = p.product_id
    AND o.status NOT IN (5, 6)
    AND o.gmt_create >= '{date_start}' AND o.gmt_create < '{date_end}'
)
